ATemptingTrap.description: Sho'Syl receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all attacks, but loses {[hp]} Health each time he is damaged by a melee attack. At the start of his third turn, he summons {[nrOfSummons]} Stealth Battlesuits plus an additional Battlesuit for each enemy unit on the battlefield. The summoned units immediately take a turn. Stealth Battlesuit stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
ATemptingTrap.name: A Tempting Trap

AblativePlating.description: Any incoming Damage with less than {[pierceRatio]}% Pierce Ratio must go through Armour three times. Does not apply to Crits.
AblativePlating.name: Ablative Plating

AdaptiveToxins.description: Each unit hit by the Hive Tyrant in melee suffers a -{[armorReduction]} Armour reduction for the rest of the battle.
AdaptiveToxins.name: Adaptive Toxins

AdrenalGlands.description: May move with +{[extraMovement]} Movement if that move ends in a hex adjacent to an enemy
AdrenalGlands.name: Adrenal Glands

AdrenalSurge.description: Each time the Screamer-Killer defeats an enemy, it gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance until the end of the battle.
AdrenalSurge.name: Adrenal Surge

AllIsDust.description: Attacks against this unit with {[pierceRatio]}% pierce ratio or less are treated as having a 1% pierce ratio.
AllIsDust.name: All is Dust

AmuletOfTheVoidwyrm.description: The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each friendly adjacent Summon or Decoy.
AmuletOfTheVoidwyrm.name: Amulet of the Voidwyrm

AncientFury.description: Normal melee attacks also deal damage to each enemy that is adjacent to both the target and Galatian. Normal ranged attacks also deal damage to each enemy that is both adjacent to the target and exactly 2 hexes away from Galatian.
AncientFury.name: Ancient Fury

AnnihilatorBeam.description: Szarekh triggers his Triarchal Menhirs to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of Szarekh's next turn any unit in those hexes is dealt {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage.
AnnihilatorBeam.name: Annihilator Beam

ArcScourge.description: Attacks an enemy unit within {[range]} hexes. Up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional units adjacent to each other are also hit, including friendly units. Enemy units that are hit receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Molecular Damage and if they are Mechanical, they are also Stunned for 1 round. For each mechanical unit hit, Belisarius Cawl gains {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance. After using Arc Scourge, Belisarius Cawl can immediately use another action.
ArcScourge.name: Arc Scourge

ArchContaminator.description: At the beginning of his turn all adjacent enemies take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage plus each hit also deals extra Damage equal to {[extraDmgPct]}-{[extraDmgPct_2]}% of the unit's max Health. Summons take double damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ArchContaminator.name: Arch-Contaminator

ArmouredMight.description: This unit’s movement is not blocked by other units, instead they get pushed and take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage. Summons and units that cannot be displaced are automatically defeated, and all units defeated by this ability are always overkilled.
ArmouredMight.name: Armoured Might

BattleFocus.description: After attacking or being attacked, moves 1 hex in a direction as far away from enemies as possible.
BattleFocus.name: Battle Focus

BigBadaBoomReworked.description: Explodes when destroyed, damaging units on adjacent hexes. Tanksmasha loses {[hp]} Health from the explosion and all other characters take {[nrOfHits]} hit that inflicts Blast Damage equal to {[dmgPct]}% of the character's maximum Health. All affected Summons are destroyed.
BigBadaBoomReworked.name: Big Boom

BioBarrage.description: The Tervigon itself and all friendly units deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% ranged Damage if they did not move in their turn.
BioBarrage.name: Bio Barrage

BladeOfMagnus.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target enemy within 2 hexes and all enemies adjacent to it. This damage is increased by +{[extraDmg]} Damage if the affected units are on Fire hexes.
BladeOfMagnus.name: Blade of Magnus

BladeOfTheAncestors.description: Ûthar gains +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage each time a friendly character dies or kills an enemy unit. Once Ûthar crits, this bonus resets.
BladeOfTheAncestors.name: Blade of the Ancestors

BlightGrenades.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to an enemy unit within range {[range]} that is not on a hex with Contamination, and up to two enemy units behind the target. This ability benefits from Indirect Fire. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
BlightGrenades.name: Blight Grenades

BlisteringAssault.description: The Screamer-Killer's normal attacks also affect all enemies adjacent to the target of the attack.
BlisteringAssault.name: Blistering Assault

BloodRunsAngerRisesWarCallsReworked.description: At the end of the Avatar of Khaine's turn, if there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} Guardian Defenders on the battlefield, he summons 2 Guardian Defenders at one of the battlefield corners. Guardian Defender stats {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
BloodRunsAngerRisesWarCallsReworked.name: Blood Runs! Anger Rises! War Calls!

BookOfFate.description: After the relic bearer performs a normal attack, a friendly adjacent Summon performs a normal attack against an enemy in range, if possible. If the summon is a Daemon, it deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage with this attack.
BookOfFate.name: Book of Fate

BossAdjutant.description: This unit takes -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage. Each time this unit is dealt damage, up to {[nrOfAttacks]} times per turn, it loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done.
BossAdjutant.name: Boss Adjutant

Bounce.description: After being attacked, has a {[chance]}% chance to be thrown to a new position within 2 hexes. If that hex is occupied, the Large Squig deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to the unit on that hex and pushes it to a random free adjacent hex. This ability can also trigger if the Large Squig is killed by an attack, unless Overkilled.
Bounce.name: Bounce

BreathOfSilence.description: Szarekh summons {[nrOfSummons]} Deathmarks on free hexes within range {[range]} from his throne starting hex.
BreathOfSilence.name: Breath of Silence

BroodProgenitor.description: Termagants in adjacent hexes deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage in their ranged attacks
BroodProgenitor.name: Brood Progenitor

Burrowers.description: This unit may burrow in its turn, disappearing from the battlefield. In its following turn it must surface and may do so in any free hex. If adjacent to an enemy unit, it may attack in melee immediately.
Burrowers.name: Burrowers

CallInReinforcements.description: At the end of the Vox-caster’s action, a Cadian Guardsman is summoned in a nearby free edge hex and immediately takes a turn. Cadian Guardsman’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallInReinforcements.name: Call In Reinforcements

CallRipperSwarms.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} burrowing Ripper Swarms, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit Ripper Swarms' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallRipperSwarms.name: Call Ripper Swarms

CallRipperSwarms2.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} burrowing Ripper Swarms, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit Ripper Swarms' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallRipperSwarms2.name: Call Ripper Swarms

CallRipperSwarms3.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} burrowing Ripper Swarms, who emerge from the ground at the beginning of the Hive Tyrant's next turn, unless their hex is occupied by another unit Ripper Swarms' stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
CallRipperSwarms3.name: Call Ripper Swarms

Catalyst.description: All friendly Tyranid units get +{[extraArmor]} Armour and a {[blockChance]}% chance to Block {[blockDmg]} Damage for the rest of this turn and the coming enemy turn.
Catalyst.name: Catalyst

ChaliceOfBaal.description: The first time each turn that any unit adjacent to Nicodemus dies, he heals himself and all friendly adjacent units for {[hp]} Health. All affected units deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with normal melee attacks until the end of this turn.
ChaliceOfBaal.name: Chalice of Baal

CloudOfFlies.description: Receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage while on a hex with Contamination. If this unit is attacked while it is not on a hex with Contamination, it has a {[chance]}% chance to contaminate the hex it is standing on.
CloudOfFlies.name: Cloud Of Flies

Conceal.description: Aeldari units within {[range]} hexes ignore their Battle Fatigue trait, if they have it, and are treated as having the Camouflage trait.
Conceal.name: Conceal

CrazedFocus.description: Deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage to enemies on hexes with a hex effect.
CrazedFocus.name: Crazed Focus

CursedOfTheWalkingPox.description: Each time this unit kills an enemy non-Mechanical unit, a Poxwalker is summoned in that hex.
CursedOfTheWalkingPox.name: Cursed of The Walking Pox

DaBossIsWatchin.description: Adjacent Orks ignore Battle Fatigue and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
DaBossIsWatchin.name: Da Boss Is Watchin'

DaGreatWaaagh.description: Ghazghkull summons {[nrOfSummons_2]} Stormboy for each enemy on the map plus {[nrOfSummons]} additional Ork Boyz, who appear on free hexes near the top of the map. Then each Ork takes a normal turn, gaining +{[extraMovement]} Movement and +{[extraHit]} hit on their melee attacks this turn.
DaGreatWaaagh.name: Da Great Waaagh!

DaRevolushun.description: Whenever an adjacent unit is defeated, Da Red Gobbo summons a Grot in its hex, unless the defeated unit was a Grot. The summoned Grot can immediately attack an adjacent enemy. Whenever a friendly Grot is defeated anywhere on the battlefield, it explodes and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all adjacent Grots and all adjacent enemies. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
DaRevolushun.name: Da Revolushun!

DaemonfleshPlate.description: Each time the relic bearer attacks, it gains +{[extraArmor]} Armour. After attacking {[nrOfAttacks]} times, this bonus is reset and the relic bearer can use its active ability again.
DaemonfleshPlate.name: Daemonflesh Plate

DawnBlade.description: Commander Farsight's melee attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each time another friendly Character within {[range]} hexes has performed a ranged attack this turn. When Commander Farsight kills an enemy unit with a melee attack, he repairs himself for {[hpToHeal]} Health.
DawnBlade.name: Dawn Blade

DeathScream.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Plasma Damage to a target enemy within range {[range]} and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[dmg_2]} Bio Damage to all enemies adjacent to the target. {[stunChance]}% chance to Stun all affected units for 1 round.
DeathScream.name: Death Scream

DeathwingKnight.description: Each time the Deathwing Knight blocks damage during an attack, all further incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReduction]} and the damage he deals is increased by {[extraDmg]} for 1 round. This effect is doubled against Chaos enemies or when standing adjacent to another friendly Dark Angel.
DeathwingKnight.name: Deathwing

DevoutPush.description: Executes a normal melee attack on a single target, then gets to move 1 additional hex.
DevoutPush.name: Devout Push

DrawFire.description: Any friendly adjacent units hit by enemy attacks have half of the hits (rounded down) hit the Terminator instead.
DrawFire.name: Draw Fire

Dw02AdvancedBurstCannon.description: Each time Re'vas attacks, she gains +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio. After attacking {[nrOfAttacks]} times, this bonus is reset, and Re'vas can use her active ability again.
Dw02AdvancedBurstCannon.name: DW-02 Advanced Burst Cannon

EchoesFromTheWarp.description: When this unit moves, it leaves a time ghost behind on the hex it moved from. The time ghost vanishes if the hex becomes occupied by another unit or if the terrain becomes impassable (as with Broken Ice). The first time this unit dies each battle, if its time ghost is on the battlefield then it revives with Full Health at its location. This works even if this unit is Overkilled.
EchoesFromTheWarp.name: Echoes From the Warp

ElectroShock.description: When this unit performs a normal melee attack, it also deals {[dmgPct]}% of its Damage to a random enemy adjacent to the target and all damaged enemies are Suppressed for 1 round.
ElectroShock.name: Electro-Shock

EmbodiedProphecy.description: During its first {[nrOfRounds]} rounds, the Zephyrim deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage, blocks an additional +{[blockDmg]} Damage and their Block chance is increased by +{[blockChance]}%.
EmbodiedProphecy.name: Embodied Prophecy

EreWeGo.description: Ghazghkull faces in one of 6 directions and prepares to charge out to range {[range]} in front of him. At the start of his next turn he charges along that path, leaving devastation in his wake. Enemy Summons in the path are automatically defeated. Each enemy Character on the path takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage and is Stunned for 1 round. Orks in the path also get Stunned for 1 round but take no Damage. All units defeated by this ability are always overkilled.
EreWeGo.name: 'Ere We Go!

Explosive.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all adjacent hexes when destroyed. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Explosive.name: Explosive

ExplosivePresents.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to an enemy unit or friendly Grot within range {[range]} and all units adjacent to the target, except Da Red Gobbo itself. This ability can be used multiple times per battle but has a cooldown of {[cooldownTurns]} rounds. This cooldown is reduced by {[cooldownReduction]} round whenever a Grot is defeated. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ExplosivePresents.name: Explosive Presents

Fealty.description: When Lion El'Jonson performs a normal melee attack, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Lion El'Jonson.
Fealty.name: Fealty

FieldsOfFire.description: Friendly units with the Emplacement trait deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage against units that are {[range]} or more hexes away from their own hex. Each time Thaddeus Noble is attacked in melee or would get Stunned, he loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done. The first time each round he loses Health this way, all friendly Emplacement units get Suppressed for 1 round.
FieldsOfFire.name: Fields of Fire

FiringPosition.description: When defeating a unit with an attack triggered by Overwatch, the Havoc stays in Overwatch, retaining {[hitsReduction]} fewer hits compared to the previous attack.
FiringPosition.name: Firing Position

FlamesOfMutation.description: When this unit gets defeated it sets its hex on Fire. Does not apply if Overkilled.
FlamesOfMutation.name: Flames of Mutation

FloatingDeath.description: Has +1 Movement when starting its turn within Synapse range. This unit explodes when it attacks or if it or an adjacent friendly Spore Mine is defeated, and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all adjacent enemies. Does not explode when overkilled. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
FloatingDeath.name: Floating Death

ForwardObservers.description: Targets an enemy unit within range {[range]} that does not have a Markerlight. The target receives a Markerlight for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. The Stealth Battlesuit then receives -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage from ranged attacks for {[nrOfRounds_2]} round.
ForwardObservers.name: Forward Observers

FragLance.description: When charging, normal melee attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage.
FragLance.name: Frag Lance

Fragstorm.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to up to {[nrOfTargets]} random hexes adjacent to the target, excluding hexes with friendly units on them.
Fragstorm.name: Fragstorm

FullThrottle.description: Whenever this unit moves {[movement]} or more hexes, there’s a {[chance]}% chance its rokkit malfunctions and causes the Storm Boy to go up in flames. In this event the unit is not revivable.
FullThrottle.name: Full Throttle

GazeOfMagnus.description: At the end of each of his turns, Magnus turns his Gaze upon an enemy Character, choosing a Psyker if possible. At the beginning of Magnus' next turn, if that character is a Psyker or attacked Magnus while under the Gaze, it takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage and if it is a Psyker, it is Stunned for 1 round. Scores +{[extraHit]}x hit for each turn in a row that Magnus targets the same character with the Gaze. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
GazeOfMagnus.name: Gaze of Magnus

GunnersKillOnSight.description: Marks an area in front of the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank for 1 round. Whenever an enemy unit without Infiltrate ends a move on a marked hex or before it moves out of the marked area, the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage to all units in the area. The ability ends early after {[nrOfCrits]} attacks against the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank have scored a Crit.
GunnersKillOnSight.name: Gunners, Kill on Sight!

HailOfLivingAmmunition.description: This unit has +{[extraHit]} hit in ranged attacks for each Termagant it is adjacent to.
HailOfLivingAmmunition.name: Hail of Living Ammunition

HarlequinsPanoply.description: The first time each turn this unit blocks a hit, all further hits of the attack are discarded and the Harlequin Player moves 1 hex closer to the origin of the attack, if possible.
HarlequinsPanoply.name: Harlequin's Panoply

HaywireMineSteppable.description: Enemies moving onto a Haywire Mine take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast. Mechanical enemies take an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
HaywireMineSteppable.name: Haywire Mine

HeadwoppasKillchoppa.description: Boss Gulgortz and all friendly Ork Boyz deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks for each enemy unit that Boss Gulgortz has defeated in this battle.
HeadwoppasKillchoppa.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa

HeavyBoltPistol.description: Deals an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Bolter Damage in melee.
HeavyBoltPistol.name: Heavy Bolt Pistol

HellfireShells.description: Fires a burst of Hellfire shells at a target within {[range]} hexes. The shells deal {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage and +{[extraHit]}x hits against Big Targets. Rapid Fire does not apply to this ability.
HellfireShells.name: Hellfire Shells

Helspear.description: Herald of the Apocalypse always adds Despoiled Ground to the hexes of affected enemies, and the next attack against affected enemies also ignores {[armorIgnored]} Armour. After Herald of the Apocalypse has been used and Haarken defeats {[nrOfUnits]} enemy units, he can use the ability again.
Helspear.name: Helspear

HostOfPlagues.description: Whenever a non-Mechanical enemy unit dies there is a {[chance]}% chance a Poxwalker is spawned on the hex where that unit died.
HostOfPlagues.name: Host Of Plagues

HungeringSwarm.description: Whenever this unit performs a melee attack, it deals +{[extraHit]} hit for each other friendly Hormagaunt or Ripper Swarm adjacent to the target.
HungeringSwarm.name: Hungering Swarm

HuntTheFallen.description: At the start of the battle, a random enemy Chaos unit is identified as Fallen. If there is no Chaos unit, a random enemy unit is designated as Deathwing Quarry. All friendly Dark Angels deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage to Fallen. Each time Baraqiel is attacked by a Fallen, he loses {[hp_2]} Health in addition to the damage done, or {[hp]} Health if attacked by Deathwing Quarry. Baraqiel takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all other attacks.
HuntTheFallen.name: Hunt the Fallen

HunterOfSouls.description: At the start of his turn, Z'Kar performs a normal attack against a target in range. This attack deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage for each adjacent friendly Psyker. Afterwards, Z'Kar leaves the battlefield and returns as Machine of War. If he is defeated while on the battlefield, he also returns as Machine of War.
HunterOfSouls.name: Hunter of Souls

HuntersInstincts.description: Gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage and takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage while on a hex with Tall Grass.
HuntersInstincts.name: Hunter's Instincts

HyperAggression.description: Beginning on its second turn, after the Screamer-Killer uses an active ability, it also performs a normal attack.
HyperAggression.name: Hyper-Aggression

Hypermorph.description: Gains extra Damage equal to {[healthPct]}% of current Health.
Hypermorph.name: Hypermorph

IllusionsOfTzeentch.description: At the start of the battle, creates a copy of the enemy team to fight for him. Copies have the same stats and ability levels as the original units. As long as one of these copies is on the battlefield, reduce all incoming damage to Thaumachus by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Each time a copied character is defeated for the first time, Thaumachus loses {[hp]} Health.
IllusionsOfTzeentch.name: Illusions of Tzeentch

ImpossibleForm.description: Each turn, the 9th attack and every 9th additional attack against Magnus deal -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage.
ImpossibleForm.name: Impossible Form

IncendiaryShells.description: Fires the Astartes shotgun at an enemy within {[range]} hexes, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage.
IncendiaryShells.name: Incendiary Shells

InstrumentsOfVengeance.description: Lion El'Jonson marks hexes in two straight lines, originating from the edges of the battlefield. At the end of this turn, if there is no enemy unit adjacent to Lion El'Jonson, he starts Overwatching. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemies on marked hexes take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} HeavyRound. Lion El'Jonson then summons {[nrOfSummons]} Deathwing Knights in free hexes on the battlefield. They can immediately attack enemies in range, but cannot move this turn. Deathwing Knight stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
InstrumentsOfVengeance.name: Instruments of Vengeance

IntegratedCircuits.description: Any time a friendly unit is Overkilled, the Menhir also takes that same amount of Damage as Direct Damage.
IntegratedCircuits.name: Integrated Circuits

IntoxicatingElixir.description: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each unit within range {[range]} that is Suppressed, Stunned, Taunted, or Thrilled, up to a maximum of {[nrOfUnits]} times. This bonus is doubled if the relic bearer is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health.
IntoxicatingElixir.name: Intoxicating Elixir

InvocationOfMachineVengeance.description: Summons {[nrOfSummons]} Tech-Priest Enginseers at the bottom of the map. Then adds {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance to all friendly Mechanical units on the battlefield. Tech-Priest Enginseer stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
InvocationOfMachineVengeance.name: Invocation of Machine Vengeance

ItsGonnaBlow.description: If this unit is Overkilled the ammo box explodes, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all adjacent hexes. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ItsGonnaBlow.name: It’s Gonna Blow

KardiocoreGalvanus.description: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each friendly adjacent Mechanical unit.
KardiocoreGalvanus.name: Kardiocore Galvanus

KissOfDeath.description: The Harlequin Player disappears and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Direct Damage to an adjacent enemy, and up to {[maxAdjacentTargets]} additional enemies adjacent to a previous target, then it reappears in a hex adjacent to the last target hit.
KissOfDeath.name: Kiss of Death

Lakrimae.description: Typhus' normal melee attacks add Contamination to the target's hex. During his turn, when a non-mechanical enemy unit within Typhus' Contagion aura is killed, he summons a Poxwalker in the hex of the defeated unit, as long as there are less than {[nrOfUnits]} friendly Poxwalkers on the battlefield. The Poxwalkers have {[summonHp]} Health and {[summonDmg]} Damage.
Lakrimae.name: Lakrimae

LethalMiasma.description: At the start of the Tervigon’s turn, any adjacent enemy units suffer {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage.
LethalMiasma.name: Lethal Miasma

Lifewards.description: If Celestine is in an adjacent hex and takes Damage, that post-Armour Damage is taken as Direct Damage by the Geminae Superia instead.
Lifewards.name: Lifewards

ListenUpMaggots.description: When Kell is in play, Lord Castellan Creed’s active ability summons 1 extra Cadian Guardsman and has {[range]} hexes range instead of 2.
ListenUpMaggots.name: Listen Up, Maggots!

LivingBatteringRam.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to an adjacent target with a {[stunChance]}% chance to stun it for 1 round. The target is also thrown 2 hexes away from the Screamer-Killer. If the hex the target lands in was occupied, the occupying unit will be pushed 1 hex in a random direction. The target is then dealt an additional {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Direct Damage, regardless if it was thrown or not.
LivingBatteringRam.name: Living Battering Ram

MartialExemplar.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to all adjacent enemies. Then moves up to {[nrOfTiles]} hex towards the closest enemy unit and performs a normal attack. These attacks and all further attacks this turn have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance against Summons.
MartialExemplar.name: Martial Exemplar

MassiveScythingTalons.description: When the Tervigon attacks an enemy in melee, any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the Tervigon take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage.
MassiveScythingTalons.name: Massive Scything Talons

Maugetar.description: During his turn, if Maugan Ra has not moved, he can move after attacking and his attacks that contain a Crit deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage. When Overwatching, Crits deal this additional hit if he has not moved in his last turn.
Maugetar.name: Maugetar

MawClawsOfThyrax.description: The relic bearer deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage for each adjacent Summon.
MawClawsOfThyrax.name: Maw-Claws of Thyrax

MischiefMakers.description: Targets of the Nurglings' normal attacks cannot be revived, healed, repaired, or otherwise restore Health for {[nrOfRounds]} round. These attacks additionally have a {[chance]}% chance to Suppress the target for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
MischiefMakers.name: Mischief Makers

MoltenForm.description: Flame, Plasma, and Melta Damage against the Avatar of Khaine is reduced by {[dmgPctReduction]}%.
MoltenForm.name: Molten Form

MonsterSlayerOfCaliban.description: Forcas deals +{[extraDmg]} Damage to Big Targets and Vehicles. He also has an added {[blockChance]}% chance to Block {[blockDmg]} Damage.
MonsterSlayerOfCaliban.name: Monster Slayer of Caliban

MortarionsPlagueWind.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage to a target within {[range]} hexes. Any enemies adjacent to the initial target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Psychic Damage. Any further enemies adjacent to at least one secondary target take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_3]}-{[maxDmg_3]} Psychic Damage. Summons take double damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
MortarionsPlagueWind.name: Mortarion's Plague Wind

MultiTracker.description: All enemy units that did not move during their turn receive a Markerlight.
MultiTracker.name: Multi-Target

MyWillBeDone.description: Immediately trigger one attack by each friendly Necron unit on the battlefield from their current hex and as long as they have a target in range.
MyWillBeDone.name: Voice of the Triarch

NeedsMoreDakka.description: Ghazghkull faces in one of 6 directions and loads up Mork's Roar as he prepares to open fire on an area in range {[range]} in front of him. At the beginning of his next turn, all units in the marked area receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage while he unleashes an intense hail of bullets. Targets adjacent to Ghazghkull receive {[nrOfHits_2]}x additional hits. Friendly Orks receive {[hitsReductionPct]}% fewer hits.
NeedsMoreDakka.name: Needs More Dakka!

NetherRealmCasket.description: The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each adjacent friendly Mechanical unit and regenerates an additional {[hpToHeal]} Health from Living Metal.
NetherRealmCasket.name: Nether-Realm Casket

NoHidingFromTheWatchers.description: Any Damage this unit takes is reduced to 0. After being attacked, this unit moves {[nrOfTiles]} hex, trying to move away from all other units. If there is no other friendly Dark Angel on the battlefield except other Watchers in the Dark, then this unit leaves the battlefield.
NoHidingFromTheWatchers.name: No Hiding from the Watchers

NoctilithBeacons.description: Szarekh and all Necrons adjacent to him take -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage from all enemies with the Psyker trait.
NoctilithBeacons.name: Noctilith Beacons

NornCrown.description: The maximum level of Neuroparasite is increased by {[effectLevel]}. Other friendly Psykers within Synapse range and friendly Summons within Synapse range deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage to enemies that are affected by Neuroparasite.
NornCrown.name: Norn Crown

NovaBoost.description: Marks all hexes adjacent to the Riptide. Trenches cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage to each enemy on marked hexes and then flies to a new location on the battlefield.
NovaBoost.name: Nova Boost

NovaCharge.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a 3-tile wide line, originating from the Riptide and additionally marks {[nrOfTargets]} hexes that are not on this line. Trenches cannot be marked. At the beginning of the Riptide's next turn, it deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage to all enemies on the hexes marked by the line, and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage to all enemies on the other marked hexes.
NovaCharge.name: Nova Charge

NovaShield.description: The Riptide gains a Shield with {[shieldHp]} Health and receives +{[blockChance]}% Block chance for {[nrOfRounds]} round. It then marks a hex on the battlefield and all hexes adjacent to it. Trenches cannot be marked. At the beginning of its next turn, the Riptide deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Particle Damage to all enemies on marked hexes.
NovaShield.name: Nova Shield

ObeisanceGenerators.description: Enemy units charging Szarekh score -{[hitsReduction]} hits, to a minimum of 1 hit. Summons charging Szarekh score -{[hitsReduction_2]} hits, to a minimum of 1 hit.
ObeisanceGenerators.name: Obeisance Generators

OiWatchIt.description: When this unit is attacked, a steppable crate of Coins is spawned in a free adjacent hex for each hit taken.
OiWatchIt.name: Oi Watch It

OmnissiahsBlessing.description: Whenever the Tech-Priest Enginseer repairs another unit, it transfers all levels of Machine Vengeance it has to the repaired unit.
OmnissiahsBlessing.name: Omnissiah's Blessing

OrbsOfDecay.description: The relic bearer's normal attacks deal an additional {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to enemy units that have their Armour reduced by {[armorReductionPct]}% or more and are also on or adjacent to the target's hex. Additionally, the target's hex is Contaminated.
OrbsOfDecay.name: Orbs of Decay

ParagonSpear.description: All of Tyrith's hits that are Crits deal the maximum possible Damage. At the beginning of Tyrith's turn, she attacks a random enemy within range {[range]} and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to it. If there is an enemy adjacent to her, this range is reduced to 1.
ParagonSpear.name: Paragon Spear

PhaeronOfTheBlades.description: All adjacent Necrons deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with melee attacks.
PhaeronOfTheBlades.name: Phaeron of the Blades

PhaeronOfTheStars.description: All adjacent Necrons deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage with ranged attacks.
PhaeronOfTheStars.name: Phaeron of the Stars

Phantasm.description: As long as there is a Phantasm, all incoming damage is reduced by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. If Eldryon becomes the target of an attack when there is no Phantasm, he moves to a random free hex and leaves a Phantasm behind, preferring hexes within range 3 if possible. This movement can traverse impassable hexes and enemies and move between any elevation. When a unit moves onto the Phantasm it is destroyed and Eldryon loses {[hp]} Health.
Phantasm.name: Phantasm

PhasalSubjugator.description: After moving, if there is no friendly Necron Warrior on the battlefield, Anuphet summons a Necron Warrior in a free adjacent hex. If Anuphet does not move, this ability triggers at the end of his turn. After My Will Be Done triggers, it triggers a second time, but only a friendly adjacent Necron Warrior that was not affected by it this turn can perform an attack. The Necron Warriors have {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.
PhasalSubjugator.name: Phasal Subjugator

PhoenixGem.description: The first time each battle that Aethana is defeated, she is instead revived with a maximum of {[hp]} Health remaining, even if Overkilled.
PhoenixGem.name: Phoenix Gem

PileIn.description: If this unit has full Health at the end of its turn, it has a {[chance]}% chance to summon another Grot in an adjacent free hex, -{[chance_2]}% for each friendly Grot currently on the board. The spawned Grot acts as normal on its next turn. Grot’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
PileIn.name: Pile In

PinpointCounterOffensive.description: Re'vas can use her active ability {[maxNrOfActivations]} times per Battle. Additionally, she takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from all attacks, but loses {[hp]} Health each time she is attacked by a unit with either the Infiltrate or Terminator Armour traits, or by a unit that has Infiltrate from an ability.
PinpointCounterOffensive.name: Pinpoint Counter Offensive

PlasmaGrenade.description: Throws a grenade at a target within {[range]} hexes, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to it and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Plasma Damage to enemy units in adjacent hexes. This ability benefits from Indirect Fire. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
PlasmaGrenade.name: Plasma Grenade

PoundThemToDust.description: Performs a normal attack and then marks an area of up to 7 hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Heavy Round Damage to all units in the marked area.
PoundThemToDust.name: Pound them to Dust!

PowerUp_Armor.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their Armour by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max Health.
PowerUp_Armor.name: Armour power-up

PowerUp_Bomb.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, triggers an explosion that deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all enemies within {[range]} hexes of the pick-up hex. The damage is increased at higher rarity tiers.
PowerUp_Bomb.name: Bomb power-up

PowerUp_Damage.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their Damage by {[dmgPct]}%.
PowerUp_Damage.name: Damage power-up

PowerUp_Healing.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up heals that unit for {[HealPercentage]}% of their max Health.
PowerUp_Healing.name: Healing power-up

PowerUp_Health.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases their Health by an amount equal to {[healthPct]}% of their max Health.
PowerUp_Health.name: Health power-up

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys Kariyan onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly characters. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is always overkilled.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_BladeChampion.name: From Golden Light

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_Uthar.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys Uthar onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly characters. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is always overkilled.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_Uthar.name: BLADE OF THE ANCESTORS

PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, deploys Aesoth onto the battlefield. They can be controlled like other friendly characters. If possible, they try to deploy onto the hex of an enemy unit, and the enemy on that hex is always overkilled.
PowerUp_HeroSpawn_VexilusPraetor.name: From Golden Light

PowerUp_Hits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of hits on their attacks by +{[extraHit]}.
PowerUp_Hits.name: Hits power-up

PowerUp_MeleeHits.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up increases the number of hits on their melee attack by +{[extraHit]}.
PowerUp_MeleeHits.name: Melee hits power-up

PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.description: When picked up by a unit, this power-up allows them to use their active ability again during the ongoing battle.
PowerUp_ReactivateAbility.name: Reactivate ability power-up

PowerUp_Reinforcement.description: Adds 1 Reinforcement point when picked up by a friendly unit.
PowerUp_Reinforcement.name: Reinforcement Point power-up

PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.description: When picked up by a unit, each deployed character in this event will deploy with a Shield equal to {[shieldPct]}% of their max Health. The shield strength accumulates with each additional Shield power-up you pick up.
PowerUp_ReinforcementShield.name: Shield power-up

PowerUp_Resurrect.description: When picked up by a friendly unit, resurrects a chosen character that has been defeated. The resurrected character spawns in a random free hex and can immediately take a turn. If there is no eligible character, it adds 1 Reinforcement point instead.
PowerUp_Resurrect.name: Resurrection power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_bloodSmnIntercessor.description: Summons Jump Pack Intercessor. Jump Pack Intercessor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_bloodSmnIntercessor.name: Jump Pack Intercessor Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnHellblaster.description: Summons Hellblaster. Hellblaster's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnHellblaster.name: Hellblaster Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnTerminator.description: Summons Deathwing Knight. Deathwing Knight's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_darkaSmnTerminator.name: Deathwing Knight Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_templSmnAggressor.description: Summons Aggressor. Aggressor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_templSmnAggressor.name: Aggressor Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnHeavyInterce.description: Summons Heavy Intercessor. Heavy Intercessor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnHeavyInterce.name: Heavy Intercessor Power-up

PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnInceptor.description: Summons Inceptor. Inceptor's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
PowerUp_SummonSpawn_ultraSmnInceptor.name: Inceptor Power-up

PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.description: If Belisarius Cawl has at least {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance at the start of his turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to all enemies on the battlefield.
PreCalibratedPurgeSolution.name: Pre-Calibrated Purge Solution

PrecisionShot.description: The Deathmark neither moves nor attacks for a turn, but instead takes aim. On its next turn, it is not allowed to move, but is able to fire its Synaptic Disintegrator with incredible accuracy, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg]} Energy Damage.
PrecisionShot.name: Precision Shot

PrehensilePincerTail.description: When the Hive Tyrant attacks an enemy in melee, that target or an enemy unit adjacent to both the target and the Hive Tyrant takes {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage.
PrehensilePincerTail.name: Prehensile Pincer Tail

PrimarchOfTheFirstLegion.description: Half of the hits (rounded down) scored against Lion El'Jonson are scored against other friendly adjacent Dark Angels instead. Friendly Dark Angels that take Damage this way deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage for {[nrOfRounds]} round.
PrimarchOfTheFirstLegion.name: Primarch of the First Legion

PriorityReclamation.description: While there is an Archeotec Crate on the battlefield, Actus receives -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage, but loses {[hp]} Health each time an enemy destroys an Archeotec Crate. At the end of his turn, if Actus is adjacent to an Archeotec Crate, he removes one Archeotec Crate and all friendly Mechanical units gain {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance.
PriorityReclamation.name: Priority Reclamation

ProperKilly.description: Always eager to engage the toughest foe, Ghazghkull's melee attack prioritises the unit with the highest current health total. He slashes with Gork's Klaw, attacking all enemies in the 3 hexes in front of him. Each target takes {[nrOfHits]} hit that deals {[dmgPct]}% of their Max Health as Power Damage. When damage is dealt this way, each target hit is also Stunned for 1 round. Afterwards each target is hit with Ghazghkull's normal melee attack.
ProperKilly.name: Proper Killy

ProphetOfGorkAndMork.description: After being attacked {[nrOfAttacks]} times in a turn, Ghazghkull takes -{[dmgPctReduction]}% Damage until the end of that turn.
ProphetOfGorkAndMork.name: Prophet of Gork and Mork

PsychicDominion.description: Magnus takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage and Psykers receive +{[dmgPct]}% Damage from his attacks.
PsychicDominion.name: Psychic Dominion

PurgeResponse.description: At the end of their turn, if the Ironkin Steeljack is adjacent to a friendly Leagues of Votann character, they start Overwatching, even if they attacked in their turn. While Overwatching, the Ironkin Steeljack's attacks ignore hit reductions.
PurgeResponse.name: Purge Response

Pyreblaster.description: When performing a ranged attack, sets the hex behind the enemy on Fire and deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to any enemy on that hex.
Pyreblaster.name: Pyreblaster

RadSaturation.description: After the Skitarii Vanguard moves, it adds Contamination to its hex. If it does not move, then this ability triggers at the end of its turn.
RadSaturation.name: Rad-Saturation

RadZoneCorps.description: At the beginning of Tan Gi'Da's turn, he deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Toxic Damage to each enemy that has their Armour reduced. At the end of his turn, he summons {[nrOfSummons]} Skitarii Vanguard at the top of the map and Contaminates one row of hexes on the battlefield. Skitarii Vanguard stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
RadZoneCorps.name: Rad-Zone Corps

Ramshackle.description: Takes -{[dmgReduction]} damage from attacks with damage types that have {[pierceRatio]}% pierce ratio or lower.
Ramshackle.name: Ramshackle

RapidFire.description: The Heavy Intercessor attacks twice if he did not move this turn, with each of the two attacks dealing Damage as normal.
RapidFire.name: Rapid Fire

ReanimationProtocols.description: If there is at least one other friendly unit of the same type on the battlefield when this unit is defeated, it has a {[chance]}% chance to be immediately revived with {[hpPct]}% of its initial Health in the same hex or a random adjacent one. Does not apply if Overkilled.
ReanimationProtocols.name: Reanimation Protocols

ReapingScythe.description: Attacks a unit in melee by swinging Silence in a wide arc, hitting the target and all enemy units adjacent to the target for {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Chain Damage. Mortarion prefers to target Psykers with this ability.
ReapingScythe.name: Reaping Scythe

RedThirst.description: If this unit is at or below {[healthPct]}% Health, it gains +{[extraDmg]} Damage and scores +{[extraHit]} hit when charging.
RedThirst.name: Red Thirst

RedemptionOfTheRisen.description: Each time a friendly Dark Angel is defeated by a Chaos enemy, Forcas loses {[hp]} Health. If a friendly Dark Angel is defeated during the enemy turn, Forcas and all friendly Dark Angels start Overwatching. As long as there is another friendly Dark Angel on the battlefield, Forcas and friendly adjacent Dark Angels take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage.
RedemptionOfTheRisen.name: Redemption of the Risen

ReinforcedHiveNode.description: Every second round – starting from the first the Tyranid Warrior is in play – the Tyranid Warrior has +100% Armour and – if it has Block – 100% Block chance.
ReinforcedHiveNode.name: Reinforced Hive Node

Reinforcements.description: At the start of Sibyll Devine’s turn, {[nrOfSummons]} Cadian Guardsmen are summoned at the top of the map and immediately take a turn. Each time a friendly Cadian Guardsman is defeated, Sibyll Devine is dealt {[dmg]} Psychic Damage.
Reinforcements.name: Reinforcements!

RelicBoltPistol.description: The relic bearer gains +{[extraPierceRatio]}% pierce ratio with melee attacks and deals +{[extraCritDmg]} Crit Damage with ranged attacks. These bonuses are doubled against Chaos or Xenos enemies.
RelicBoltPistol.name: Relic Bolt Pistol

RelicOfLostCadia.description: Friendly surrounding Imperial Summons have Final Vengeance. When the relic bearer is defeated, summons a Cadian Guardsman in its hex with {[summonHp]} Health, {[summonDmg]} Damage and {[summonArmor]} Armour.
RelicOfLostCadia.name: Relic of Lost Cadia

RelicPowerFist.description: The relic bearer's attacks that deal Power Damage have a {[chance]}% chance to Suppress and a {[chance_2]}% chance to Stun enemies targeted by them. These chances are doubled if the attack is an active ability.
RelicPowerFist.name: Relic Power Fist

Reveal.description: An enemy within {[range]} hexes that is not Revealed and has defeated a friendly Aeldari unit this battle becomes Revealed for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. Friendly Aeldari that attack Revealed enemies ignore any hit reductions and deal +{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage.
Reveal.name: Reveal

RevoltinglyResilient.description: When attacked, each hit after the first {[nrOfHits]} hits in that same attack deals {[dmgPctReduction]}% less Damage than the previous hit. The first {[nrOfHits]} hits of each attack deal normal damage, the next hit 50% damage, the next hit 25%, etc.
RevoltinglyResilient.name: Revoltingly Resilient

SabreOfSacrifice.description: When Dreir or Death Riders adjacent to Dreir are charging, their attacks Suppress their targets for 1 round. After charging and until the start of their next turn, they additionally have +{[extraArmor]} Armour for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle.
SabreOfSacrifice.name: Sabre of Sacrifice

SaviorProtocols.description: If a friendly adjacent T'au Empire unit is attacked, there is a {[chance]}% chance for each hit to be scored against this Drone instead of the original target. When moving, this Drone prioritises hexes adjacent to friendly T'au Empire units. When attacking, this Drone tries to prioritise enemies with a Markerlight.
SaviorProtocols.name: Saviour Protocols

ScarabSummon.description: Summons another Scarab Swarm in a free adjacent hex, which then immediately takes a turn.
ScarabSummon.name: Scarab Summon

ScreamerInvocation.description: The first time there are no allied Daemons on the battlefield at the end of his turn, Abraxas summons {[nrOfSummons]} Screamers onto random hexes on the battlefield. When a friendly Daemon is defeated, Abraxas loses {[hp]} Health. As long as there are friendly Daemons on the battlefield, all incoming damage to Abraxas is reduced by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Screamer of Tzeentch stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
ScreamerInvocation.name: Screamer Invocation

ScytheOfDust.description: Mesophet does a mighty sweep with his scythe, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to all enemies in adjacent hexes.
ScytheOfDust.name: Scythe of Dust

ScythingTalons.description: Attacks an enemy in melee for {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage and any enemy units adjacent to that target and to the Tyranid Warrior take {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bio Damage. Double hits against Summons.
ScythingTalons.name: Scything Talons

SelfRepairMechanism.description: Beginning with the end of round {[nrOfRounds]}, at the end of each of his turns, Belisarius Cawl repairs himself for {[hpToRepair]} Health for each level of Machine Vengeance he has.
SelfRepairMechanism.name: Self-Repair Mechanism

SelfRepairMechanismReworked.description: Beginning with the end of round {[nrOfRounds]}, at the end of each of his turns, Belisarius Cawl gains + {[extraArmor]} Armour for each level of Machine Vengeance he has.
SelfRepairMechanismReworked.name: Self-Repair Mechanism

Shrapnel.description: The Mortar Team's ranged attack deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to {[nrOfProjectiles]} random hexes adjacent to their target. Units hit are also Suppressed.
Shrapnel.name: Shrapnel

ShroudPsalm.description: Up to {[nrOfTargets]} other friendly units gain {[effectLevel]} levels of Machine Vengeance and are affected by Shroud Psalm until the start of their next turn. Affected units have +{[extraArmor]} Armour and normal attacks against them score -{[hitsReduction]} hits, to a minimum of 1.
ShroudPsalm.name: Shroud Psalm

SlashingDive.description: Flies over and deals a wave of damage from an initial melee target to targets up to 2 hexes behind. {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[0]]} Power Damage to first target, {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[1]]} Power Damage to the second, and {[nrOfHits]}x {[dmg[2]]} Power Damage to the third. Lands in the hex directly behind the last target hit, or - in case that hex is occupied - to the closest free hex to it.
SlashingDive.name: Slashing Dive

SolarAtomizer.description: Transfers all levels of Machine Vengeance from other friendly Mechanical units to Belisarius Cawl. Additionally Belisarius Cawl faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide. At the beginning of his next turn, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage to all enemies on affected hexes.
SolarAtomizer.name: Solar Atomizer

SoulHunger.description: Enemy Psykers take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Psychic Damage when using Active abilities or Smite within {[range]} hexes from the Hive Tyrant. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
SoulHunger.name: Soul Hunger

SpawnTermagants.description: Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} Termagants, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there. Termagant’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpawnTermagants.name: Spawn Termagants

SpawnTermagants2.description: Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} Termagants, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there. Termagant’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpawnTermagants2.name: Spawn Termagants

SpawnTermagants3.description: Summons 1-{[maxSummons]} Termagants, starting with the hex in front of the Tervigon and then propagating to free hexes from there. Termagant’s stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage {[summonArmor]} Armour
SpawnTermagants3.name: Spawn Termagants

Split.description: When this unit gets defeated, it summons 2 Blue Horrors in adjacent hexes. Does not apply if Overkilled. Newly summoned Blue Horrors can immediately attack an enemy if summoned during the Pink Horror's turn, but cannot move until their next turn. Blue Horror's stats: {[summonHp]} Health {[summonDmg]} Damage
Split.name: Split

StaffOfStars.description: Hapthatra unleashes the full power of the Staff of Stars, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to an initial target and {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Energy Damage to all enemies adjacent to that target. Summons take double Damage.
StaffOfStars.name: Staff of Stars

Stikkbomb.description: Throws a grenade at a target, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to the target and {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to units in hexes adjacent to the target. Range {[range]} and Indirect Fire applies.
Stikkbomb.name: Stikkbomb

StormOfFlensingBlades.description: Attacks an adjacent enemy twice in a row, as long as the Flayed One started the turn adjacent to it.
StormOfFlensingBlades.name: Storm of Flensing Blades

StormboyzStrike.description: In its first turn this unit flies into any free hex, instead of starting on its designated spawn point. There's a {[chance]}% chance it misses its designated hex and ends up in a random adjacent hex instead. This fly-in counts as a movement for Full Throttle.
StormboyzStrike.name: Stormboyz Strike

StranglethornCannon.description: The Hive Tyrant attacks using its Stranglethorn Cannon, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to an initial target within {[range]} hexes. Any units adjacent to the target suffer {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Blast Damage.
StranglethornCannon.name: Stranglethorn Cannon

SupaCyborkBody.description: The relic bearer can be healed as well as repaired and additionally takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each adjacent enemy unit.
SupaCyborkBody.name: Supa-Cybork Body

SynapticBacklash.description: Whenever the Tervigon sustains a Crit, friendly Termagants within {[range]} hexes are also dealt {[dmgPct]}% of that attack’s Damage.
SynapticBacklash.name: Synaptic Backlash

SynapticImperative.description: All friendly units adjacent to this unit have a {[chance]}% chance to be revived at {[hp]} Health when suffering lethal Damage, unless Overkilled. This can only happen once per unit per turn.
SynapticImperative.name: Synaptic Imperative

SynapticInsight.description: This unit's ranged attacks score +{[extraHit]} hits against targets that are within Synapse range or adjacent to another Tyranid.
SynapticInsight.name: Synaptic Insight

TalismanOfRage.description: Each time the relic bearer defeats an enemy with a melee attack, it counts twice for Blessings Of Khorne. The relic bearer takes -{[critDmgReduction]} Crit Damage for each level of Blessings Of Khorne.
TalismanOfRage.name: Talisman of Rage

TalonOfHorus.description: When Abaddon performs a normal melee attack, he also deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power Damage to all enemies adjacent to both the target of the attack and to Abaddon.
TalonOfHorus.name: Talon of Horus

TargetLock.description: At the beginning of the Riptide's turn, it deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage to all enemy units with a Markerlight.
TargetLock.name: Target Lock

TargetingProtocols.description: Sets up to fire on {[nrOfTargets]} hexes. These hexes light up with light pillars and at the start of the Menhir's next turn any unit in those hexes is hit by an Annihilator Beam and is dealt {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Piercing Damage.
TargetingProtocols.name: Targeting Protocols

TheArdentBlade.description: The first time each turn that Celestine defeats an enemy unit, she resurrects one of her Geminae Superia with {[hp]} Health in a free adjacent hex. If they cannot be resurrected, then one of them within {[range]} hexes takes an action instead.
TheArdentBlade.name: The Ardent Blade

TheBloodyHanded.description: Other friendly Aeldari units are Unstoppable and deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage against enemies standing on Fire.
TheBloodyHanded.name: The Bloody Handed

TheEmperorsShield.description: Each hit scored by a melee attack against Lion El'Jonson increases his Block chance by +{[blockChance]}% until the end of this turn. Every time Lion El'Jonson blocks {[nrOfAttacks]} or more hits of a melee attack against him, he deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct to the attacker.
TheEmperorsShield.name: The Emperor's Shield

TheLantern.description: Conjures a miasma of pestilence in one of six directions that fills a 3x3 hex area adjacent to Mortarion. Enemy units hit by the miasma are Suppressed. At the beginning of Mortarion's next turn he fires The Lantern's beam in an arc over the affected area, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Energy Damage to each enemy unit in the area. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TheLantern.name: The Lantern

TheLionsWrath.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Power to an adjacent enemy unit and Taunts it for {[nrOfRounds]} round. At the beginning of his next turn, if the targeted unit is still adjacent to Lion El'Jonson, he deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Piercing to it. All attacks triggered by this ability have a {[chance]}% Chance to score a Crit with their second hit, even if the first hit did not score a Crit.
TheLionsWrath.name: The Lion's Wrath

TheWailingDoomStrikes.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide and originating from the Avatar of Khaine on Fire, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage to all enemies on affected hexes.
TheWailingDoomStrikes.name: The Wailing Doom Strikes

TheWailingDoomSweeps.description: Faces in one of 6 directions and sets a cone of hexes in range 2 in front of it on Fire, dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage to all enemies on affected hexes. At the beginning of its next turn, deals {[nrOfHits_2]}x {[minDmg_2]}-{[maxDmg_2]} Melta Damage to all enemies on affected hexes.
TheWailingDoomSweeps.name: The Wailing Doom Sweeps

TheWildHost.description: Reduces all incoming damage by {[dmgReductionPct]}%. Aethana loses {[hp]} Health each time she is attacked. At the beginning of Aethana's turn, units on marked hexes take {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage, and she marks all hexes of units that attacked her last turn. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TheWildHost.name: The Wild Host

TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashedReworked.description: At the beginning of the Avatar of Khaine's next turn, he deals Flame Damage to all enemies within {[range]} hexes, except enemies on healing hexes. This attack deals {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage per hit and scores {[nrOfHits]} hits against surrounding enemies, {[nrOfHits_2]} hits against enemies at range {[range_2]}, and {[nrOfHits_3]} hits against enemies at range {[range]}. Then all Fire in the affected area is extinguished, and all adjacent enemies are pushed one hex.
TheWrathOfKhaineUnleashedReworked.name: The Wrath of Khaine Unleashed

TheWrathfulDead.description: On each of his turns, {[nrOfSummons]} Poxwalkers spawn on the map in random free hexes, preferring hexes that are not adjacent to enemy Characters. The spawned Poxwalkers don't move on the turn they are summoned, but will attack a target in range if there is one. Any time a friendly unit is defeated, Corrodius also takes Direct Damage equal to {[healthPct]}% of the defeated unit's maximum Health.
TheWrathfulDead.name: The Wrathful Dead

TreasonOfTzeentch.description: Teleports an enemy character to another random hex and creates a copy of the character in its old location. The copy fights on the side of Magnus and has {[hpPct]}% of the original character's maximum Health. All other stats and ability levels are identical.
TreasonOfTzeentch.name: Treason of Tzeentch

TunnelingHorror.description: This unit may use tunnelling to move. It is then removed from the battlefield and emerges in its chosen hex at the start of its next turn, pushing any unit in that hex aside. It is then able to immediately attack any adjacent enemy in melee.
TunnelingHorror.name: Tunnelling Horror

TzeentchsFirestorm.description: Marks all hexes exactly {[range_2]} hexes away from Magnus in a ring around him. At the beginning of his next turn, all enemy units on marked hexes receive {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Flame Damage. For the next 2 turns, the process repeats, reducing the ring radius by {[range]} and increasing hits to enemies in marked hexes by {[extraHits]} each turn. Magnus can move independently of the ring after the initial turn of casting. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
TzeentchsFirestorm.name: Tzeentch's Firestorm

UnbridledCarnageReworked.description: At the end of Tanksmasha's turn, Grots and Explosive Oil Drums rain from the sky. If an Explosive Oil Drum gets destroyed, it explodes, damaging units on adjacent hexes. Tanksmasha loses {[hp]} Health from the explosion and all other characters take {[nrOfHits]} hit that inflicts Blast Damage equal to {[dmgPct]}% of the character's maximum Health. All affected Summons are destroyed.
UnbridledCarnageReworked.name: Clusta Bomma Precishun Strike

UnparalleledFerocity.description: Deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Physical Damage to all adjacent enemies, with a 100% Crit Chance againstSummons.
UnparalleledFerocity.name: Unparalleled Ferocity

UnstoppableFerocity.description: Scores one additional hit when attacking an enemy Psyker. Scores one additional hit when charging.
UnstoppableFerocity.name: Unstoppable Ferocity

ValkyrieStrike.description: Calls in an air strike on a target hex anywhere on the battlefield, which gets marked with red smoke. After one round, the target hex and two random surrounding hexes are hit with Hellstrike Missiles, each dealing {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Blast Damage. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
ValkyrieStrike.name: Valkyrie Strike

VengeanceForTheOmnissiah.description: Whenever an adjacent friendly Mechanical is defeated, the Tech-Priest Enginseer gains {[effectLevel]} level of Machine Vengeance.
VengeanceForTheOmnissiah.name: Vengeance for the Omnissiah

Vitarus.description: The hexes of each enemy hit by Mephiston's normal melee attack or by Fury of the Ancients are set on Fire. If these attacks hit enemies on hexes with Fire, they deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and extinguish the Fire.
Vitarus.name: Vitarus

Volatile.description: If this unit is Overkilled it deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Bolter Damage to all adjacent tiles. This ability's Damage ignores all of the attacker bonuses and modifiers (including elevation), and cannot Crit.
Volatile.name: Volatile

VoltagheistField.description: If Health is restored to this unit, the amount restored is reduced by {[healthPct]}% and it then scores +{[extraHit]} hit with normal attacks until the end of its turn.
VoltagheistField.name: Voltagheist Field

VolummsMasterArtifice.description: After Vynn or friendly E-COGs have performed +{[nrOfRepairs]} repairs, Vynn heals for {[hpToHeal]} Health and can use his active ability again.
VolummsMasterArtifice.name: Vôlumm's Master Artifice

VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.description: Each time this unit is dealt Flame Damage or Blast Damage, it loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done. This unit takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from hits that do not deal Flame Damage or Blast Damage.
VulnerableToFlameAndBlast.name: Vulnerable to Flame and Blast

VulnerableToMelee.description: Each time this unit is dealt Damage by a Melee attack, it loses {[hp]} Health in addition to the damage done. This unit takes -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Damage from attacks that are not Melee attacks.
VulnerableToMelee.name: Vulnerable to Melee

WallOfMirrors.description: If the Stealth Battlesuit has not moved, it disappears from its current hex and reappears on a free hex on the battlefield from which it can perform a normal ranged attack against an enemy that has a Markerlight. This attack has +{[extraPierce]}% Pierce Ratio.
WallOfMirrors.name: Wall of Mirrors

WarConstruct.description: For 1 round, if there is no enemy adjacent to the Wraithguard, it shoots back at each enemy within range that attacks it or a friendly adjacent Aeldari.
WarConstruct.name: War Construct

WatchedOver.description: Adjacent friendly units take -{[dmgReductionPct]}% Psychic Damage from enemy attacks and if they have a Block chance, that Block Chance is increased by +{[blockChance]}%. Enemy Psykers will not hit an additional unit with their normal ranged attacks when attacking units that are adjacent to a Watcher in the Dark.
WatchedOver.name: Watched Over

WeakerRearArmour.description: If enemies are inside the rear arc of the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank, their attacks have +{[extraCritChance]}% Crit Chance against it.
WeakerRearArmour.name: Weaker Rear Armour

WhipcoilBody.description: This unit takes -{[dmgReduction]} Damage from melee attacks.
WhipcoilBody.name: Whipcoil Body

Wraithcannon.description: When performing a ranged attack, deals {[nrOfHits]}x {[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Direct Damage to an enemy behind the target.
Wraithcannon.name: Wraithcannon

WyrdmakersHelm.description: During his turn, each time Baldr or an adjacent friendly unit gets healed for the first time this turn, Baldr immediately performs a normal melee attack. These attacks deal +{[extraDmg]} Damage and add Ice to the target's hex.
WyrdmakersHelm.name: Wyrdmaker's Helm
